newsitem.title: DUBAI: Saudi Arabia beheads man for murder.
newsitem.headline: Saudi Arabia beheads man for murder.

text.p: Saudi Arabia on Sunday beheaded a man for murder, Saudi state television reported.
It quoted an interior ministry statement as saying the man killed another man by striking him on the head with a pistol in a dispute. He was executed in Jeddah.
The television did not give the nationalities of the men.
The beheading brought to 46 the number of people executed in Saudi Arabia this year.
The conservative kingdom strictly enforces Islamic sharia law by publicly beheading by the sword convicted murderers, drug smugglers, rapists and other criminals.
